mn82:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thullakoṭṭhitaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo tadavasari.
mn82:2.2: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kurūsu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ thullakoṭṭhitaṃ anuppatto
mn82:2.3: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
mn82:2.4: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā
mn82:2.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti
mn82:2.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
mn82:2.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
mn82:3.1: atha kho thullakoṭṭhitakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu appekacce bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
mn82:3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho thullakoṭṭhitake brāhmaṇagahapatike bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
mn82:4.1: tena kho pana samayena raṭṭhapālo nāma kulaputto tasmiṃyeva thullakoṭṭhite aggakulikassa putto tissaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
mn82:4.3: yathā yathā khvāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ
mn82:4.4: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti.
mn82:5.1: atha kho dullakoṭṭhitakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmiṃsu.
mn82:6.1: atha kho raṭṭhapālo kulaputto acirapakkantesu thullakoṭṭhitakesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho raṭṭhapālo kulaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

mn82:6.3: icchāmahaṃ bhante kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ
mn82:6.4: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
mn82:6.6: anuññātosi pana tvaṃ raṭṭhapāl mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyāti.
mn82:6.7: na khohaṃ bhante anuññāto mātāpitūhi āgārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyāti.
mn82:6.8: na kho raṭṭhapāla tathāgatā ananuññātaṃ mātāpitūhi puttaṃ pabbājentīti.
mn82:6.9: svāhaṃ bhante tathā karissāmi yathā maṃ mātāpitaro anujānissanti agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyāti.

mn82:7.3: icchāmahaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ
mn82:7.5: evaṃ vutte raṭṭhapālassa kulaputtassa mātāpitaro raṭṭhapālaṃ kulaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ

mn82:7.9: kiṃ pana mayaṃ taṃ jīvantaṃ anujānissāma agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyāti.

mn82:13.2: atha kho bhagavā acirūpasampanne āyasmante raṭṭhapāle aḍḍhamāsūpasampanne thullakoṭṭhite yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi
mn82:13.3: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthī tadavasari.
mn82:13.4: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn82:14.1: atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
mn82:14.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn82:14.3: aññataro kho panāyasmā raṭṭhapālo arahataṃ ahosi.
mn82:15.1: atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

mn82:16.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena thullakoṭṭhitaṃ tadavasari.

mn82:18.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa ñātidāsī ābhidosikaṃ kummāsaṃ chaḍḍetukāmā hoti.
mn82:18.2: atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo taṃ ñātidāsiṃ etadavoca
mn82:18.3: sace taṃ bhagini chaḍḍanīyadhammaṃ idha me patte ākīrāti.
mn82:18.4: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa ñātidāsī taṃ ābhidosikaṃ kummāsaṃ āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa patte ākīrantī hatthānañca pādānañca sarassa ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.
mn82:18.5: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa ñātidāsī yenāyasmato raṭṭhapālassa mātā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa mātaraṃ etadavoca
mn82:18.8: sace je saccaṃ bhaṇasi adāsiṃ taṃ karomīti.
mn82:18.9: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa mātā yenāyasmato raṭṭhapālassa pitā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa pitaraṃ etadavoca
mn82:19.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā raṭṭhapālo taṃ ābhidosikaṃ kummāsaṃ aññataraṃ kuḍḍaṃ nissāya paribhuñjati.
mn82:19.2: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa pitā yenāyasmā raṭṭhapālo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ etadavoca
mn82:19.3: atthi nāma tāta raṭṭhapāla ābhidosikaṃ kummāsaṃ paribhuñjissasi
mn82:19.4: nanu tāta raṭṭhapāla sakaṃ gehaṃ gantabbanti.
mn82:19.5: kuto no gahapati amhākaṃ gehaṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ
mn82:19.7: agamamhā kho te gahapati gehaṃ tattha neva dānaṃ alatthamhā na paccakkhānaṃ
mn82:19.10: alaṃ gahapati kataṃ me ajja bhattakiccanti.
mn82:19.11: tenahi tāta raṭṭhapāla adhivāsehi svātanāya bhattanti.
mn82:20.1: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa pitā āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa adhivāsanaṃ viditvā yena sakaṃ nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā haritena gomayena paṭhaviyā upalimpetvā mahantaṃ hirañña suvaṇṇassa puñjaṃ kārāpetvā dve puñje kārāpetvā ekaṃ hiraññassa ekaṃ suvaṇṇassa mahantā puñjā ahesuṃ. orato ṭhito puriso pārato ṭhitaṃ purisaṃ na passati tathā pārato ṭhito orato ṭhitaṃ te puñje kilañjehi paṭicchādāpetvā majjhe āsanaṃ paññāpetvā tirokaraṇīyaṃ parikkhipitvā āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa purāṇadutiyike āmantesi
mn82:20.2: etha tumhe vadhuke yena alaṅkārena alaṅkatā pubbe puttassa raṭṭhapālassa piyā hotha manāpā tena alaṅkārena alaṅkarothāti.
mn82:21.1: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa pitā tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa kālaṃ ārocesi
